family_definition: One authored utterance and all of its voice variants; each family belongs to one split. General phonetic categories are shared across splits.

en: Please book my appointment for Monday at five thirty.
Five available visits fit very well on Friday afternoon.
Would you move the blue room booking to two o'clock?
I would like Wednesday... actually, make that Thursday morning.
No, do not cancel it. Keep the appointment as it is.
The first option is too early, so please check a later time and tell me what is available.
zh: 麻烦帮妈妈预约明天下午三点半的服务。
非常方便的话，请安排周五上午的访问。
我想把中午的预约改到周二下午五点。
我想约在周三，等一下，还是改到周四早上吧。
不要取消这个预约，请保留原来的时间。
请把 meeting 改到下周，再给我一个确认消息。

en: Bob may bring a paper map before the meeting begins.
Violet found four fresh flowers beside the front window.
Choose the new room with two blue stools near the door.
The delivery arrives on October twenty ninth at eleven fifteen.
Your reference number is six zero eight, followed by nine two.
This is a price estimate, and it does not include the deposit.
Let me check the address... yes, the second building is correct.
You can leave the package by the side entrance, thank you.
After the morning session finishes, we can discuss the remaining questions and decide which documents are still needed.
Maybe Peter will prepare a proper plan before breakfast tomorrow.
I heard Saturday at ten forty, but please confirm the month.
Could you explain why the evening workshop has moved upstairs?
zh: 爸爸把白色背包放在旁边的木板上。
服务负责人发现房间里还有一份文件。
叔叔坐在屋外，慢慢喝了一口温水。
包裹会在十月二十八日上午九点二十分送到。
查询编号是七零四，再加上八六两个数字。
这个金额不包含押金，也不是最终的账单。
我先看看地图，稍等一下，入口应该在左边。
东西放在门口的小桌子上就可以了，谢谢。
上午的讨论结束以后，我们再检查剩下的材料，并决定下一次见面需要准备哪些文件。
门边摆着八把木椅，每把旁边都有一本书。
我听到的是星期六十点四十分，请再确认一下月份。
收到邮件以后，请把新的 address 发给 Linda 确认。
